title: c100
content:
A Linux®-powered mini-PC, designed to run Workbench.

The c100 is designed for offices, workshops, labs, and factories. Built around a full-size mechanical keyboard, with tool storage and a removable lid. c100 folds with its magnetic hinge, for closed operation or reclaiming bench space.
